Let $\lambda,\mu\in X_{*}(T)$ with $\lambda$ dominant.

1.

We have

$\overline{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}\cap S_{\mu}\neq\varnothing\ \Longleftrightarrow\ L_{\mu}\in\overline{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}\ \Longleftrightarrow\ \mu\in\mathop{\mathrm{Conv}}(W\lambda)\cap(\lambda+Q^{\vee}),$

where $\mathop{\mathrm{Conv}}$ denotes the convex hull.

2.

If $\mu$ satisfies the condition in (1),
the intersection $\overline{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}\cap S_{\mu}$ has pure
dimension1313
13

By this, we mean that all the irreducible components of this variety have dimension $\langle\rho,\lambda+\mu\rangle$ . $\langle\rho,\lambda+\mu\rangle$ .

3.

If $\mu$ satisfies the condition in (1),
then $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}\cap S_{\mu}$ is open dense in $\overline{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}\cap S_{\mu}$ ; in particular, the irreducible components of $\overline{\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}}\cap S_{\mu}$ and $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G}^{\lambda}\cap S_{\mu}$ are in a canonical bijection.
card.label: Theorem 5.2

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
